title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: Any board member with a financial interest in a contract must abstain from its vote. Some members without a financial interest also abstain. Board member Eva voted on the contract. Board member Ivo abstained; his financial interests are not reported.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
